summary: OpenAI-enriched Library card bodies were destroyed by teacher/circle during expansion-perfection-cycle. Enrichment progress counters survived; card text did not.

facts.wipeVector: scripts/pipeline/teacher.mjs previously rmSync(content/corpus) then rewrote only synthesis concepts
facts.recoverability: Enriched prose not recoverable from local disk (no git history of large index). Must re-enrich via OpenAI when quota available.

rootCause: Aggressive automation ran a destructive republish path without a pre-check that cardCount/enrichedCount would drop, and without a restore backup.
fixesApplied: teacher merges previousIndex instead of wiping corpus
productTrustNote: Learner purchases (Guide unlock / AI Premium) are StoreKit entitlements and on-device saved cards — separate from Merixa corpus pipelines. Paid coach access must not imply Merixa can silently delete published Library depth without backup; pipeline safeguards above are the operational control.
